summary: Hydrate missing objects in partial-clone source repositories before local evidence signing, including blobs reachable only through history; refuse signing clearly if hydration fails.

rules.detail: Evidence signatures and verifier requirements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Complete repositories behave as before. Partial clones fetch missing objects from their existing promisor remote before the scratch fetch.

recovery.detail: Hydration only adds Git objects; no refs are changed. No rollback concerns.
